payload.text: Brennecke Institute developed a thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery intended to suppress electrolyte crossover, a key aging mechanism. The independent audit established the governing cycle life as 8,400 cycles, while confirming a gravimetric energy density of 148 Wh/kg and a 4 °C operating-temperature floor, below which the dopant precipitates and cycling must stop. Projected stack-level cost at 500 MWh manufacturing scale is $61/kWh.
